rows.name: Taco Kellz
rows.notes: Birria taco pop-up (birria tacos, lumpia, wontons) founded by Kelly Ramones; no storefront. Seed side Ewa/Kapolei (leeward_ewa), but stops are island-wide. Rotating stops: website lists Tuesdays at Kaiser High School Farmers Market 4-6 PM; KHON2 (Mar 2026) said Thursdays at Wai Kai 4-8 PM; IG bio lists stops such as 1st Fridays Waikele Center. These conflict or are time-sensitive, so check the IG bio for the current week. Facebook page not found. The website has a 'Ready to Order?' section, but I could not see the order mechanism, so order_url is the site itself.

rows.name: Takoyaki Yamachan
rows.notes: Honolulu (Town). Own location page lists Don Quijote Kaheka, 801 Kaheka St, daily 10AM-7PM, and KCC Farmers Market, 4303 Diamond Head Rd, Saturdays 7-11AM. The brand also has a San Francisco location. The IG handle comes from the Made in Hawaii directory listing, not the brand's own site, so it is unverified and may cover both Hawaii and California. The madeinhawaii.tv listing gives the site as takoyakiyamachan.com; I verified takoyakiyamachan.net. The site's structured data shows 1450 Ala Moana Blvd, which conflicts with the Kaheka address, so treat that address as unreliable. Facebook not found. No brand-owned order link found; only DoorDash/Uber Eats listings, which I did not use.

rows.name: Tango Empanadas
rows.notes: Siblings Julieta and Lucas Garnil. Main trailer at Kahuku Sugar Mill (56-565 Kamehameha Hwy, North Shore). Honolulu trailer at 401 Atkinson Dr, across from Ala Moana Center, opened spring 2026 and open Wed-Sun per Aloha State Daily (May 2026). IG handle @tangoempanadashi is stated by Star-Advertiser, Aloha State Daily and HI Now. Website lists farmers market stops (Waimea Valley Thursdays, Fisherman's Wharf Ala Moana Fridays, Kailua Sundays), but that page may be dated, so check IG for current stops. Orders are in person, by Instagram or by text per Star-Advertiser (Oct 2025). Facebook not found.

rows.name: Top End Grindz
rows.notes: Candidate IG @top_end_grindz (https://www.instagram.com/top_end_grindz/, 435 posts, a cooking-focused bio) matches the name, but the snippet shows no location, products or Windward link, so I could not tie it to this exact Oʻahu business. A MapQuest listing shows a 'Top End Grindz LLC' at 1529 Adelaide St, Honolulu 96819, which is not Windward. Left null per the no-guessing rule. Facebook and website not found. Activity status unknown.

rows.name: Tutu's Place
rows.notes: Tūtū's Place is a café by Highway Inn at Bishop Museum, 1525 Bernice St, Honolulu 96817 (Kapālama; Town). Opened Sept 2025 per KHON2 and Highway Inn's press release. It is a fixed location, so there is no market schedule. The press release says open daily from 10:30 a.m. The page says walk-in only, no reservations. Lau lau, squid lūʻau and poi are served Aloha Fridays and Saturdays. A Highway Inn menu PDF is headed '@tutusplace', which suggests an Instagram handle, but it does not name the platform, so I left Instagram null. Facebook not found. Website is the Highway Inn parent site. I did not find a separate Tutu's Place site. Take-out ordering on the page covers only the Kakaʻako and Waipahu locations.

rows.name: Waba Snacks
rows.notes: Korean bungeoppang (fish-shaped pastry) and mini taiyaki, Honolulu. Own website says a new store is opening at Kakou Food Hall inside YouMe Mart (711 Keeaumoku St), with an anticipated May 1, 2026 opening. Until then it was at various Oʻahu markets. I could not confirm that the new store opened. Older storefronts (961 Kawaiahao St, 333 Ward Ave) are listed as closed on directory sites, which I did not use as sources. The IG handle comes from a chamber-of-commerce listing that links instagram.com/wabasnacks and matches the Facebook page and website name. I could not open the IG page itself. Seed side says Central, but all addresses found are in Honolulu town. No schedule or order link beyond the website.

rows.name: goodneighbors bento
rows.notes: IG bio: Makiki Farmers Market every Thursday; Japanese bento and katsu slider; vegan friendly; DM to place a pre-order (hence order_url = IG). Listed as a vendor at the Japanese Cultural Center of Hawaiʻi Craft & Collectibles Fair (2454 S Beretania St) in April, August and September 2026. The fair pages are organizer lists. Website and Facebook not found.

rows.name: HI Thai Food
rows.notes: The only match I found is 'HI Thai Food Truck' in Wailuku, Maui (Facebook: facebook.com/hithaimaui). That is not Oʻahu, and nothing ties it to an Oʻahu vendor, so I left it all null. No seed location was given. If an Oʻahu business by this name exists, I need its location or an organizer link.
